column1: # label-axes.tsv (harbor#978) — every issue label as <axis>:<value>, and the legacy label each one replaces.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. contracts/issue-taxonomy.tsv is the connector's only list of labels (harbor#512), but the
# standard says every label is `<axis>:<value>` (D-30) and the family axis already lives in terms.tsv: two lists
# would drift. This file holds the axes, their cardinality and the mapping from each bare or `theme:` label, and
# `sh bin/lint-name.sh --gen issue-taxonomy` renders the connector's format and a legacy-to-new map from it into
# untracked build/naming/. Nothing is renamed on GitHub by this file: creating, renaming or deleting a label is an
# operator write (harbor#978), and the connector keeps reading contracts/issue-taxonomy.tsv until that sitting.
# COLUMNS  id <TAB> axis <TAB> value <TAB> legacy <TAB> globs <TAB> min <TAB> max <TAB> status <TAB> meaning
#   id      the label as it will be on GitHub; an axis row's id is the axis name
#   value   the value after the colon; `-` on an axis row, which carries min and max (cardinality per issue)
#   legacy  the label today, `-` for an axis row; a family row maps the `theme:` label of the same name
#   globs   tracked-path patterns that suggest the label, or `-`
#   status  ok, or gap: a theme with no family of its name, kept as a `theme:` label until a person registers
#           the family or maps it (operator sitting B, harbor#949)
